title: Does anyone know where I can find an early Katheryn Bigelow short film?

commenti.body:
(Sorry if this is a double list but I got a message that my previous comment was removed for being too short.) 

Anthology Film Archives appear to have a copy that they screened earlier this year. Seems like it was a physical film copy but you could reach out to them and see if there’s a digital version you can access? (Or maybe view in person if you’re in the area- I think they’re in NYC. Not really sure how these things work but it’s worth asking.)

what is your source that mubi streamed it? from all sources it is just currently just on film.

words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words words

Hi, I'm pretty sure the listing on Mubi doesn't mean it was available to stream. Mubi lists a lot of movies as 'Unavailable to stream' that you could never stream in the first place and have never been streamable anywhere. I am willing to be corrected though! I'm pretty sure the only place you can watch it is at whatever screenings it may have at Anthology Film Archives or MoMA or wherever. 

I wish you the best of luck. Maybe you could email her, seriously. I've done the same to directors before, and in a few cases I've actually had luck, although I did approach them through professional connections rather than cold-calling.
